definitions.gloss: discerning eye, keen insight, sharp perception
definitions.explanation: The ability to perceive the true nature of things clearly. A formal/literary word emphasizing exceptional judgment and perception.

examples.japanese: {慧眼|けいがん}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}
さすが{社長|しゃちょう}、お{慧眼|けいがん}ですね。
examples.english: As expected of the president, you have excellent judgment.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{慧眼|けいがん}は、{誰|だれ}も{気|き}づかなかった{問題|もんだい}を{見抜|みぬ}いた。
examples.english: His keen insight detected a problem that no one else had noticed.

notes:
FORMALITY: Formal/literary. Often used to praise someone's judgment, especially in business or formal contexts.

USAGE: Commonly used with お{慧眼|けいがん} as a polite expression praising someone's discernment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慧眼|けいがん}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし} (person of keen insight)
- お{慧眼|けいがん} (your excellent judgment - honorific)
- {慧眼|けいがん}を{持|も}つ (to have keen insight)

RELATED WORDS:
- {洞察力|どうさつりょく} (insight, perception)
- {先見|せんけん}の{明|めい} (foresight)
- {眼力|がんりき} (discerning eye - less formal)
